api.name: changeBgpPeersForVpc
api.description: Change the BGP peers for a VPC.

params.name: vpcid
params.description: UUID of the VPC which the Bgp Peers are associated to.

params.name: bgppeerids
params.description: Ids of the Bgp Peer. If it is empty, all BGP peers will be unlinked.

response.name: project
response.description: the project name of the bgp peer

response.name: domainid
response.description: the domain ID of the bgp peer

response.name: details
response.description: additional key/value details of the bgp peer

response.name: projectid
response.description: the project id of the bgp peer

response.name: jobid
response.description: The UUID of the latest async job acting on this object

response.name: domain
response.description: the domain name of the bgp peer

response.name: zoneid
response.description: id of zone to which the bgp peer belongs to.

response.name: jobstatus
response.description: The current status of the latest async job acting on this object

response.name: created
response.description: date when this bgp peer was created.

response.name: zonename
response.description: name of zone to which the bgp peer belongs to.

response.name: account
response.description: the account of the bgp peer
